about: T1.33 part 3's acceptance tests that failed when the independent test author wrote them, before the implementation, on lane 1a's 03896356 (T1.33 part 2 with its catalog fix), on the owner's answers of 2026-10-14 (items 24 and 26) and the orchestrator's big-integer rule. 'rust-host': rows through real DuckDB (rust/crates/sdm-testkit/tests/t133p3_reads.rs): contract/type-set-vectors.json's rows with `cells` (the lossless types read, not left out; HUGEINT, UHUGEINT and VARINT as int64, decimal128(38, 0) or text by the big-integer rule, each cell DuckDB's exact text) and contract/t133p3-vectors.json's text_time rows (rel-trial's time-named text, refused text_time today). 'exits': packages/structured-data-models-client/tests/test_the_schema_route.py's text_time cases flipped to text ('py:test_the_schema_route::<test id>'). Each listed test must still fail (strict); the implementer takes an id out of 'pending' once it passes, and changes nothing else: 'pending' stays within 'authored', which is the test author's. Added on 9de3d1dc (the test author's): the big-integer tier decided for the whole column, rows lossless.hugeint-wide-after-preview and varint-wide-after-preview (a 1,200-row users whose values past int64 come after the 1,000 a preview reads; today received int64); and the differential's text_time read under DT-15, approved, never pending the owner (contract/tests/test_t133_umbrellas.py and test_t133_differential_classes.py, 'py:<file stem>::<test id>'). Added on 08c531b5 (the test author's, fix round 1): the row varint-key.decimal of contract/t133p3-vectors.json (rust-host), a VARINT key (users.user_id and orders.user_id) received decimal128(38, 0), which materialize fails with an unnamed PROVIDER_ERROR today, its int64 and text controls passing; and 'host-vendor', the tests of rust/crates/sdm-host/tests/t133p3_vendor.rs (by test name), an arrow.opaque field of another vendor or none decoded by DuckDB's layout through sdm_host::admit today, where it must be admitted as its storage is, as before part 3. Added on 59a4efef (the test author's, round 2): rows uhugeint-key.low-bits and uhugeint-key.past-37-digits (rust-host), a lossless UHUGEINT key in the decimal tier whose users 6 and 7 differ in low bits only, where a seed cast to HUGEINT joins one user's rows under the other's instance today; hugeint-key.past-37-digits and bigint-key.control pass. The 'host-vendor' tests through admit_from with DuckDB declared (duckdb_declared_another_vendor_s_opaque_types_are_admitted_as_before_part_3, duckdb_declared_opaque_types_naming_no_vendor_are_admitted_as_before_part_3, duckdb_declared_duckdb_s_opaque_types_are_read) pass at 59a4efef and are not gated. Added on ab60e89f (the test author's, round 3): rows mixed-key.negative-zero and mixed-key.exponent-doubles (rust-host), a DECIMAL(38, 0) users.user_id against a DOUBLE orders.user_id, -0.0 for user 0 and the exponent-form doubles 10^16 + 16k, where the seed join by printed text gives an instance none of its orders today; each instance's orders and labels are held to DuckDB's own numeric join (`want.related`), as are the controls bigint-double-key.control and the round 2 key rows, which pass.
